name: sc5_wallx
goal: Scenario 5, human interference, with the cap (scenario 1 recipe): harness reads the label (90291 -> zone 2 -> right arm) -> WALLX picks + places (90 calls, head camera only, re-plans every call); a person moves the cap once mid-grasp.
